person.name: Giovanni Lupo
standfirst: I make small apps and build every part myself,
down to the server they run on.

items.name: XA
items.line: A camera for iPhone with film filters, date stamps and purikura.

items.name: NDPass
items.line: Photograph a ticket stub and it reads the venue, date and seat.

items.name: m-cas
items.line: A tape recorder with one long tape per trip, wound with your thumb.

items.name: Bunko
items.line: An e-reader styled after Japanese paperbacks, with ribbon bookmarks.

items.name: TapeDelay
items.line: Sports scores and alerts that wait until your stream catches up.

items.name: BlockBliss
items.line: An 8×8 block puzzle with no ads or revives. It never goes online.

items.name: SupernoteIOS
items.line: A Supernote app for iPhone and iPad that syncs like another Supernote.

sections.title: Shops
sections.intro: I built these at LR Paris. Every shop on [lrparisstore.com](https://lrparisstore.com) runs on them, each in its own container on one shared server.

sections.title: Light Phone
sections.intro: Apps for a phone whose home screen is a list of words.

items.name: BrightMarket
items.line: An app store for sideloaded Light Phone apps. Anyone can submit.

items.name: Roll
items.line: A camera for the Light Phone III. The wheel works as a lens ring.

items.name: BrightControl
items.line: Makes the wheel and camera button work in any app.

items.name: BrightKeyboard
items.line: The Light Phone keyboard in every app, plus swipe typing.

items.name: BrightMailbox
items.line: Separates letters from notices, and can stop at five letters a day.

sections.outro: To list an app in BrightMarket, add it to [brightmarket-index](https://github.com/gi-os/brightmarket-index).

sections.title: Systems

items.name: GI-OS
items.line: A desktop in a browser tab. Started in 2015, now on version 7.

items.name: PassportOS
items.line: An operating system in C for the gi-os Passport.

items.name: June
items.line: A Discord bot that works as a personal secretary.

sections.outro: Most of this is Swift, Kotlin or Node, with SQLite, React, Docker, nginx and bash.
